scientific_integrity: An analytic all-order proof establishes an exact entrywise-positivity threshold for the classical four-stage RK4 diffusion map on triangular graphs and every strongly regular graph with the same intersection parameters; independent publication and mathematical validation are not asserted.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the end-of-step matrix for symmetric unit-weight graph diffusion, not internal stages, nonlinear generators, or arbitrary edge weights.
Specialist publication-priority coverage outside inspected records may remain.
Exact rational finite computations support the analytic proof but cannot replace an infinite-family proof.
title: Sharp RK4 positivity horizons on triangular graph diffusion
